s4.p2: 4.2. Payment is made either on delivery (cash or card) or online via payment methods we accept.

dataProtectionPolicy.title: Data Protection Policy
dataProtectionPolicy.intro: Thank you for using our website. Protecting your personal data is important to us. In this privacy policy, we explain how we collect, use and protect your data.

s1.title: 1. Data We Collect
s1.p1: We may collect personal data such as your name, delivery address, phone number and e-mail address when you place an order or contact us via the contact form.
s1.p2: We collect information about your interactions with our website, such as pages visited, clicks, preferences and settings.
s1.p3: We collect information about the device you use to access our website, including IP address, browser type, operating system and device identifiers.
s1.p4: When you pay with Stripe or PayPal, we and Stripe or PayPal collect information about your payment method, such as your credit card number.

s2.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
s2.p1: We use your data to process and deliver your order. We use Stripe and PayPal for payment processing.
s2.p2: We use your contact details to send order confirmations, delivery notifications and updates. If you have subscribed to our newsletter, we may also send you information about special offers and new products.
s2.p3: We analyse your data to improve our website and send you relevant offers if you have agreed to this.

s3.title: 3. Data Storage and Protection
s3.p1: We store your personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, unless a legal retention obligation applies.
s3.p2: We take appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data from loss, misuse and unauthorised access. We use SSL encryption to ensure the security of data transmission.

s4.title: 4. Data Sharing and Third Parties
s4.p1: We may share your personal data with third-party providers who assist us with order processing, delivery, payment processing (e.g. Stripe and PayPal) or other services. These third parties are contractually obliged to use your data only for the specified purpose and to take appropriate security measures.
s4.p2: We may disclose your data where required by law.
s4.p3: Our website uses Google Maps to display location information. By using Google Maps, you are subject to Google's terms of use and privacy policy. We have no influence over data processing by Google.
s4.h4: 4.4. App Store and Play Store links:
s4.p4: Our website may provide links to app stores to allow you to download our mobile application. Please note that when using the App Store or Play Store, you agree to the terms and privacy policy of the respective operator.
s4.p5: Our website may contain links to social media platforms. Please note that these platforms have their own privacy policies for which we are not responsible. When you click these links, you leave our website and are subject to the privacy rules of the respective platform.
s4.p6: We use cookies and similar technologies to track and improve your use of our website. Further information can be found in our cookie policy.

s5.title: 5. Your Rights
s5.p1: You may request a copy of your personal data.
s5.p2: You may ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
s5.p3: You may request that we delete your data. In some cases, however, we must retain certain data.
s5.p4: You may request restriction of the processing of your data.
s5.p5: You may request that we provide your data to you in a structured format.
s5.p6: You may object to the processing of your data, in particular where it is used for direct marketing.

s6.title: 6. Changes to This Privacy Policy
s6.p1: We may update this privacy policy from time to time to reflect changes in our data protection practices. We recommend checking regularly for updates.
s6.p2: If you have questions or concerns about your personal data or this privacy policy, you can contact us at any time.
